jelling.name: Jelling Stones
jelling.slogan: Two mounds, two runestones, and the start of Denmark.
jelling.line: The larger stone, raised around 965 by Harald Bluetooth, is the first written record of the name Denmark.

ribedomkirke.name: Ribe Cathedral
ribedomkirke.slogan: 248 steps up for the marsh and the sea in one view.
ribedomkirke.line: Denmark's oldest cathedral rests on a bishopric first recorded in 948, and its Commoners' Tower stands 52 metres tall.

legohouse.name: LEGO House
legohouse.slogan: Twenty-one giant bricks stacked into a playground.
legohouse.line: Opened in 2017 and designed by BIG, it holds 25 million bricks, including a 15-metre Tree of Creativity.

koldinghus.name: Koldinghus
koldinghus.slogan: A royal castle that learned to live with its scars.
koldinghus.line: Burned in 1808, it stood as a ruin for generations before the Exners rebuilt it in wood and steel, earning a Europa Nostra award in 1993.

ribesvikinger.name: Museet Ribes Vikinger
ribesvikinger.slogan: Meet the traders who made Ribe a market town.
ribesvikinger.line: Ribe's Viking-age marketplace flourished between 710 and 850, making it one of Scandinavia's oldest towns.
